## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Evidence

Record commands and exact outcomes, including failures and skips. Distinguish local validation, GitHub CI, deployment, and observed customer behavior.

## Review notes

- Identify contract/schema/security changes and their regression coverage.
- Keep secrets, customer records, local databases, and generated artifacts out of Git.
- For database changes, link the reviewed data-preserving plan and isolated localhost integration evidence.
- For visible UI changes, include desktop, tablet, 375px, and keyboard checks.
- Update capabilities and the API changelog when behavior changes; preserve source provenance.

## Rollout

State remaining limitations and the separately authorized deployment/rollback steps, if applicable.
